auth_details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints accept query parameters only; no API key, OAuth, or signup.
free_tier_limits: Fully free public APIs; no paid tier on api.gdeltproject.org. Soft limit typically treated as ~1 request per 5 seconds by community clients; no official free-tier quota page.
rate_limits: Not formally published with hard numbers on official docs; community clients and GDELT MCP enforce ~1 request per 5 seconds. Exceeding may yield errors or throttling.
description: The GDELT Project monitors worldwide broadcast, print, and web news and exposes free realtime JSON APIs (DOC, GEO, TV, Context) for full-text search, geographic mapping, television monitoring, and contextual snippets. Data is also available as bulk downloads and via Google BigQuery. No signup or API key is required for the public v2 APIs at api.gdeltproject.org.
resolution_notes: Settling free_tier_limits and rate_limits disputes with live official sources.
